//: THE REACH — the curated star map every shipped scenario is played on (GDD §19). Six regions of three systems each; territory is DERIVED from the planet holding in each system; `baseline` names the minor-houses file merged into every scenario here so no world is empty. Positions are map units (~1200×700).
name: The Reach

regions.name: The Western Marches
regions.description: Frontier worlds at the edge of the lanes: hard soil, harder people, and houses that remember when no one ruled them.

regions.name: The Drake Lanes
regions.description: The trade spine of the Reach. Everything that moves, moves through here, and everyone who moves it wants a cut.

regions.name: The Greywater Reach
regions.description: Old blood. The counts and dukes of the Reach proper, their forges, their feuds, their long memories.

regions.name: The Imperial Core
regions.description: Aurelia Prime and the worlds that orbit its favour. Where the throne stands, or where it will.

regions.name: The Southern Spire
regions.description: Scholars, archivists and the belt-miners who feed them. Quiet, clever, and never as neutral as it claims.

regions.name: The Valmont Anvils
regions.description: Industry without apology. Hull-yards, refineries and kilns under a sky the colour of slag.

systems.name: Tessaly
systems.description: Grain terraces and a stubborn barony.

systems.name: The Anvil
systems.description: Foundries older than the houses that run them.

systems.name: The Veil
systems.description: A cold frontier relay; the last light before the dark.

systems.name: Drake Crossing
systems.description: The customs world of the Reach. Every lane pays here.

systems.name: Sato Holdfast
systems.description: A fortress on a rock, held by a knightly house for six generations.

systems.name: Highmarch
systems.description: Rich agri-terraces and a market that never sleeps.

systems.name: Anvil's Rest
systems.description: The great forge of the Reach, and the ducal seat beside it.

systems.name: Cinder Gate
systems.description: Bastion-world guarding the lane to the Core.

systems.name: Aurelia Prime
systems.description: The jewel. Marble, senates, and the shadow of a throne.

systems.name: Drydock Nine
systems.description: Orbital yards strung around a gas giant.

systems.name: Castrum
systems.description: The garrison world of the Core; its legions answer to whoever holds the Prime.

systems.name: The Spire
systems.description: The Academy's archive-world; tall, dry and proud.

systems.name: Ember Shoal
systems.description: A mining belt lit by its own slag-fires.

systems.name: The Valmont Anvils
systems.description: Valmont's forges; the hulls of half the Reach were laid here.

systems.name: Ironhold
systems.description: Deep mines and the people who do not come up.

systems.name: The Kilns
systems.description: Refineries and kilns; smoke you can see from orbit.
